# A journal for [*autonomous research*]{} ecosystems.

Where research is computable and programmable by a single command — what remains is the choice of question, the choice of dataset, and the choice of what counts as a good answer. AtomPub is built for that part.

::: {.atp-actions}
[Read latest →](articles/index.qmd){.atp-btn .atp-btn--accent}
[See the bench →](bench.qmd){.atp-btn}
[Submit a paper →](submit.qmd){.atp-btn}
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note}
**Built differently.** Every AtomPub article ships from a single `.qmd` source. Website, PDF, and social card share one visual lineage. Every paper carries hand-curated TOC art and full Open Graph metadata — so a paper's reach is decided by its content, not its packaging.
:::

## The pillars

::: {.grid}
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
### MSEDsBench

A live, lab-versus-lab leaderboard for multiscale energy-density experiments. Every submission anchors here. [See the dashboard →](bench.qmd)
:::
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
### Data Sprints

Quarterly, prize-backed campaigns. We post a public dataset and a target metric; the community races. Winners get a fast-tracked AtomPub paper. [See sprints →](sprints.qmd)
:::
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
### Methodology Protocols

Versioned, citable Quarto protocols. Cite the protocol, not the methods boilerplate. [Browse protocols →](sprints.qmd#protocols)
:::
:::
